chunk:
description: |
  Canonical installation job / work order entity for construction/contracting integrations.
  Maps from: construction ERP (ComputerEase, Procore, Sage 300 CRE, Viewpoint),
             CRM (Salesforce Opportunity), contractor portals (HD Portal, ServiceTitan).
  Maps to: any system in the job lifecycle (scheduling, billing, reporting, customer portal).
  Common synonyms by system: Job (ComputerEase), Project (generic ERP), Opportunity/Order (Salesforce),
                              Order (HD Portal), Work Order (field service systems).

  Known Peerless-specific format: jobNumber = "{YY} HD {sequential-counter} {sales-rep-initials}"
  e.g. "26 HD 565 AS" — counter managed in Object Store by MuleSoft.

required:
  - jobId
  - customerId
  - status
  - jobType
  - timestamps

properties:
  jobId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical job identifier
    example: "JOB-2026-000565"

  externalIds:
    type: object
    description: Source system identifiers
    properties:
      erpJobNumber:       { type: string, description: "Job number in construction ERP (e.g. ComputerEase '26 HD 565 AS')" }
      portalOrderId:      { type: string, description: "Order/lead ID in contractor portal (e.g. HD Portal)" }
      salesforceOpptyId:  { type: string, description: "Salesforce Opportunity ID" }
      salesforceOrderId:  { type: string }

  customerId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-customer (the homeowner/property owner)

  contractId:
    type: string
    description: Links to canonical-contract (the signed installation contract)

  status:
    type: string
    enum: [LEAD, QUOTED, CONTRACTED, SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETE, CANCELLED, ON_HOLD]

  jobType:
    type: string
    description: Type of installation work
    example: "FENCE_INSTALLATION"

  product:
    type: object
    description: What is being installed
    properties:
      material:     { type: string, description: "Fence material (e.g. WOOD, VINYL, CHAIN_LINK, ALUMINUM, STEEL)" }
      style:        { type: string, description: "Fence style/design" }
      linearFeet:   { type: number, description: "Total linear feet of fence" }
      panels:       { type: integer }
      gates:        { type: integer }

  location:
    $ref: '#/Address'
    description: Job si
